snippet.title: Mandew vs the Colorless Curse - Steam Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Mandew vs the Colorless Curse was originally released in 2012 and available on the Suits & Sandals website. The game is now coming to Steam with a brand new OST, Leaderboard support and a myriad of other changes and updates.

Steam store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1447410/Mandew_vs_the_Colorless_Curse/
New OST by Jaxcheese: https://jaxcheese.bandcamp.com/
